items.lede: A hacker obtained personally identifiable information about more than 40,000 Homeland Security staffers, which has since been published online.
items.title: Hacker stole personnel data about thousands of Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents

items.lede: A hacker stole a trove of personal information from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The breach exposes the names, job titles, phone numbers, email addresses, and office locations of more than 41,000 employees, including those in US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP), according to TechCrunch and Wired.
